name: settle

NOTE: a bridge 'p' message moves the ENGINE and a __TW.setParam moves the PAGE. The panel's own selectors and faders only follow the second, the plan polygon and the RT readout only the first, so a plate of a CHANGED panel has to send both.
--- nine surfaces: the hall treated as a STUDIO, a carpet and a cloud in the living room
eval: (function(){ var B=window.__JUCE__.backend, TW=window.__TW; [['mat3',4/4],['mat1',2/4],['flr1',1/5],['cel1',1/5],['mat2',1/4]].forEach(function(p){ B.emitEvent('tw',{k:'p',id:p[0],v:p[1]}); TW.setParam(p[0],p[1]); }); return 'materials set both sides'; })()

name: let the rooms retune and both views redraw
what the panel now shows, and what the rooms ring for (250/1k/4k/8k)
eval: (function(){ var TW=window.__TW; var sel=[].slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.matgrid select')).map(function(s){ return s.options[s.selectedIndex].textContent; }).join(' '); var s=TW.scene(); return sel + '   |   ' + s.rt.map(function(r){ return r.map(function(v){ return v.toFixed(2); }).join('/'); }).join('  '); })()

name: ctrl-materials (nine selectors, three rooms by three surfaces)
--- break four walls: push the split point out of the room
eval: (function(){ var B=window.__JUCE__.backend, TW=window.__TW; [['fold1a',0.5+0.45/1.2],['foldp1a',0.3],['fold1b',0.5+0.35/1.2],['foldp1b',0.68],['fold3a',1.0],['foldp3a',0.34],['fold3b',0.5+0.5/1.2],['foldp3b',0.7]].forEach(function(p){ B.emitEvent('tw',{k:'p',id:p[0],v:p[1]}); TW.setParam(p[0],p[1]); }); return 'folded both sides'; })()

name: let the plan polygons and the 3D room follow
the rooms really did get bigger (plan polygon vertex counts)
eval: (function(){ var s=window.__TW.scene(); return s.plan.map(function(p){ return p.length+' pts'; }).join(', '); })()

name: ctrl-folds (the broken-wall rows: depth and where the break sits)
plan-folded (the flat with four walls broken and splayed outward)
--- flat walls and factory materials again
eval: (function(){ var B=window.__JUCE__.backend, TW=window.__TW; ['fold1a','foldp1a','fold1b','foldp1b','fold3a','foldp3a','fold3b','foldp3b'].forEach(function(id){ B.emitEvent('tw',{k:'p',id:id,v:0.5}); TW.setParam(id,0.5); }); [['mat1',1/4],['mat2',1/4],['mat3',2/4],['flr1',0],['cel1',0]].forEach(function(p){ B.emitEvent('tw',{k:'p',id:p[0],v:p[1]}); TW.setParam(p[0],p[1]); }); return 'flat again'; })()

name: let the leaf settle into the frame and the view redraw
put the pointer on the handle
eval: (function(){ var TW=window.__TW; TW.render(); var h=TW.handlePos('door1'); var p=TW.project(h); if(!p) return 'HANDLE NOT ON SCREEN (handle at '+h+')'; var pov=document.getElementById('pov'); pov.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove',{bubbles:true,pointerId:11,clientX:p[0],clientY:p[1]})); return 'handle at '+h.map(function(v){return v.toFixed(2);}).join(',')+' -> screen '+Math.round(p[0])+','+Math.round(p[1])+'  hover='+TW.hoverDoor+'  cursor='+document.getElementById('pov').classList.contains('handle'); })()
